customSql.name: SSP Booked Services (Custom SQL)
customSql.sqlQuery:
SELECT spy_sales_order_item.id_sales_order_item, spy_sales_order_item.fk_sales_order, spy_sales_order_item.sku, spy_sales_order_item.name AS service_name, spy_sales_order_item.quantity, spy_sales_order_item.created_at, spy_sales_order_item_metadata.scheduled_at, spy_oms_order_item_state.name AS state_name, spy_sales_order.order_reference, spy_sales_order.store, spy_sales_order.customer_reference, spy_sales_order.company_uuid, spy_sales_order.company_business_unit_uuid, spy_company.name AS company_name, spy_company_business_unit.name AS company_business_unit_name, spy_sales_product_class.name AS product_class_name
       FROM spy_sales_order_item
         INNER JOIN spy_sales_order_item_product_class ON spy_sales_order_item.id_sales_order_item = spy_sales_order_item_product_class.fk_sales_order_item
         INNER JOIN spy_sales_product_class ON spy_sales_product_class.id_sales_product_class = spy_sales_order_item_product_class.fk_sales_product_class
         LEFT JOIN spy_sales_order_item_metadata ON spy_sales_order_item_metadata.fk_sales_order_item = spy_sales_order_item.id_sales_order_item
         LEFT JOIN spy_oms_order_item_state ON spy_oms_order_item_state.id_oms_order_item_state = spy_sales_order_item.fk_oms_order_item_state
         LEFT JOIN spy_sales_order ON spy_sales_order.id_sales_order = spy_sales_order_item.fk_sales_order
         LEFT JOIN spy_company ON spy_company.uuid = spy_sales_order.company_uuid
         LEFT JOIN spy_company_business_unit ON spy_company_business_unit.uuid = spy_sales_order.company_business_unit_uuid
WHERE spy_sales_product_class.name = 'Service'
